profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at U.S. Bank
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the information technology and services industry. Skilled in Customer Service, Web Applications, Agile Methodologies, Troubleshooting, and Web Design. Strong quality assurance professional with a Bachelor of Science (B.S.) focused in Computer Software Engineering from Miami University.

positions.title: Software Test Engineer
positions.description:
•	Perform functional and end-to-end testing for our solutions
•	Identify and communicate product enhancements discovered during testing activities
•	Collaborate with members of the development team to promote efficient test practices 
•	Led automation testing for web user-interface, RESTful web services and build verifications 
•	Oversaw the completion of web user-interface automation suite as a project manager
•	Documented test automation guidelines for ease of knowledge sharing across team

positions.title: IT Support Desk  - Student Master
positions.description:
•	Provide the best customer service to Miami University faculty, staff, and students via phone, chat, or email.
•	Troubleshoot client problems to the best of my abilities while providing excellent customer service at the same time.

positions.title: Center for Information Management - Assistant
positions.description:
•	Provide customer support to students and faculty who have questions pertaining to the technology in the lab.
•	Maintain the lab space during opening and closing by cleaning electronic devices.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
•	CSE 201: Introduction to Software Engineering
•	Attended labs to answer student questions regarding the a wide range of topics. This included  software development cycles such as agile, waterfall, etc.
•	Provided helpful feedback on student's homework and lab work.

positions.title: IT Intern
positions.description:
•	Verify testing and business requirements for commercial applications through manual testing
•	Use Agile project management methodology which consists of daily standup meetings and two week iterations in order to complete tasks
•	Strengthen QA organization through feedback

volunteerExperiences.description: At the Girls of Color Hackathon, I taught the girls how to use MIT App Inventor.

Techie Club is an after school education program tied directly to national Computer Science standards for 3rd – 6th grade students. Every fall since 2015, I’ve taught local elementary students about various technologies including 3D Printing, Web Development, and Programming.
